ops.title: Extract tool-result types to cc_transcript/tools.py with per-tool result classes
ops.description: ToolResultBlock gains verbatim `tool_use_result` (Mapping | str | None); tools.py gains the result hierarchy (BashResult, EditResult, WriteResult, ReadResult, TaskResult/TaskLaunchResult, SkillResult, AskUserQuestionResult, TextResult, OtherResult) + TOOL_RESULT_TYPES + parse_tool_result; typed join at activity.ToolUse.typed_result (result block doesn't know its tool name at parse time). TodoWrite stays untyped.

ops.text: ToolResultBlock.tool_use_result carries the record-level payload verbatim in both backends; is_async derived from it
parse_tool_result returns the right typed class per tool with TextResult/OtherResult degradation; activity.ToolUse.typed_result joins by tool name
tests/test_fence.py and tests/test_import_weight.py stay green (tools.py stdlib-only)
